scenarios.title: The All-Time Greats Dinner
scenarios.text: A legend of the game invites you to a private dinner at his home with a few others like him: no cameras, no phones, a long table, and a rule that nobody talks about statistics.

choices.label: Listen to every story
choices.result: Every story, listened to, all night long, from men who played before you were born. You drive home at midnight feeling like you've been handed something to keep.

choices.label: Tell your own
choices.result: One story of your own, about the hardest week of your career. The table goes quiet, then the legend raises his glass of water to you, and the others follow.

choices.label: Help in the kitchen
choices.result: The evening spent helping the legend's wife in the kitchen, plating dessert and hearing the stories that never made the papers. They're the best ones.
